3. By way of the instant application, the applicant seeks modification of condition no. (ii) imposed vide order dated 20.09.2022 passed in the above- captioned bail application by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court for grant of anticipatory bail in case arising out of FIR bearing no. 112/2020,
registered at Police Station Mansarovar Park, Delhi for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A/304B/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 which reads as under:
"...(ii) The petitioners shall not leave the NCT of Delhi without the prior This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 29/06/2025 at 23:45:12 permission of the concerned Trial Court..."
4. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the applicant herein is the wife of co-accused Subodh Chand Dixit and is a permanent resident of Etawah, Uttar Pradesh.

He states that the husband of the applicant herein has been retired from the post of lab technician in Pratima Dixit vs State on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157405297/
1 UCMS in GTB Hospital and both of them used to regularly visit their hometown to look after their agricultural land and parental home.

sentences.text: Further, the applicant is also looking for a bridegroom for her daughter, for that she has to travel outside Delhi alongwith her husband.
Thus, the applicant prays that the abovesaid condition be modified.

5. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the chargesheet has already been filed in the present case, the said condition is modified to the extent that 'the applicant may leave the NCT of Delhi for the reasons stated above, but not outside the country without the permission of the learned Trial Court'.
6. In view of above, the application stands disposed of.
7. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J MAY 09, 2025/
